sources.title: BrowserAI - Local LLMs in your browser
sources.snippet: BrowserAI leverages WebAssembly and WebGPU to run increasingly efficient small language models directly in your browser. Integration just takes a few lines of code - no APIs required.

sources.title: Web AI Showcase — find & run any model in your browser
sources.snippet: web ai showcase Every model, running in your browser. No servers, no API keys, no uploads. Each model here loads and runs locally on your device — with a hands-on control panel, a look inside what it's doing, and real use cases. 🔎 Explore all models by intent →

sources.title: Run AI Models Directly in the Browser with Transformers.js
sources.snippet: Run AI models directly in the browser using Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime, and WebAssembly for private, offline, low-latency inference without a backend server.
